subject: Film & Cinema
title: Nollywood: Africa's Film Factory
description: One-minute skill: Nollywood: Africa's Film Factory.

hook.text: Nigeria produces more films per year than Hollywood. Most people outside Africa don't know.

buildup.text: Nollywood emerged in the 1990s using cheap video and direct-to-market distribution.

discovery.text: Films are shot fast, sold on DVD or streamed, and reflect everyday Nigerian life.

twist.text: Western critics dismissed the quality, but audiences across Africa made it a cultural powerhouse.

climax.text: Nollywood proved cinema doesn't need Hollywood's infrastructure to reach millions.

punchline.text: The world's second-largest film industry hid in plain sight.

quiz.question: How does Nollywood compare to Hollywood in output?
options: It produces more films per year
